baseline.entry_point: fixed 100 x 50 replay: DPR Reader relevance_logit -> Answer Scorer Top-k; stored qore_common_order is the matched QORE baseline
baseline.equivalence_test: Computed relevance Top-5 IDs must exactly equal stored topk_common_order IDs for all 100 cases; QORE IDs are read unchanged from qore_common_order.

core_invariants: The retrieved Top-50, candidate identity/order, K=5, DPR Reader model output trace, QORE selection, Generator, evaluator, and answer path are fixed.
The online selector receives only five DPR Reader signals and passage text/title for redundancy calculation; Silver/gold/panel labels are opened only after all predictions are frozen.
This is a fixed-slice L0 diagnostic, not a full-data result or a claim of answer accuracy.
No training, weight fitting, or Silver-driven threshold selection is allowed in this screen.
The fixed four-qubit circuit has zero trainable parameters; its classical Born control must match exactly and no quantum-advantage claim is possible from this screen.

interfaces.output_schema: per-question deterministic Top-5 IDs, scores, and set-level redundancy selection
invariants: Exactly 50 unique IDs and ranks 1..50 per question.
All feature values are finite and normalized within question.
Output contains exactly five unique IDs from the original Top-50.

plugins.insertion_point: after the frozen DPR Reader relevance/span heads and before Top-5 output
plugins.hypothesis: The historical relevance-only ordering is the direct reference for any span-signal intervention.
plugins.input_schema: 100 x 50 pinned compact Reader trace and candidate identity
plugins.output_schema: Top-5 by descending relevance_logit with retrieval-rank/id stable ties
failure_signatures: any case differs from stored topk_common_order

emitted_fields: all 5,000 candidate IDs/ranks/relevance values and per-method selected order
shape_dtype_normalization: stable descending score ties by retrieved rank then ID

plugins.insertion_point: after the frozen DPR Reader heads and before Top-5 output
plugins.hypothesis: A fixed equal-weight relevance/evidence blend can rescue sharply localized answer spans without using labels or learning weights.
plugins.input_schema: question-normalized relevance, best span, span margin, and negative mean start/end entropy
plugins.output_schema: one finite scalar fusion score per candidate
failure_signatures: Silver overlap below both stored baselines
broad/direct evidence falls while redundancy rises
baseline parity or finite-value check fails

emitted_fields: all 5,000 candidate features and classical scores
shape_dtype_normalization: population z-score clipped to [-3,3] then divided by 3

plugins.insertion_point: after the frozen DPR Reader heads and before Top-5 output
plugins.hypothesis: A shallow entangling map over relevance, localized span, boundary margin, and concentration can express joint Reader-signal interactions that a relevance-only score misses.
plugins.input_schema: four question-normalized DPR Reader features in [-1,1]
plugins.output_schema: one Born-expectation score per candidate, plus a matched exact classical parity score
plugins.resource_estimate: 4-qubit exact statevector per candidate; 4 CNOT, abstract two-qubit depth 2, 0 trainable parameters
failure_signatures: no span-signal gain over both stored baselines

output_fields: local Z and ring ZZ expectations
emitted_fields: all 5,000 candidate feature vectors, circuit scores, classical Born scores, and selected order

trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: all 100 fixed questions and all 50 candidates in registered order
trace_contract.target_boundary: fixed Top-50 -> Top-5 only; no retrieval, Reader rerun, labels during scoring, Generator, or evaluator

five unique stable IDs are selected from the input Top-50
redundancy-aware selection lowers the synthetic duplicate rate

compact output size and authenticated exchange manifest receipt validation

reproducibility.dataset_identity: Silver-oracle Top-5 case study, fixed 100 x 50, SHA-256 669ce1018ec502f02bf2a4a76420c7cb9b4e2f17b250c5420b6bcf01fc1d5731
reproducibility.environment: Collaborator-local Python with project NumPy; wrapper discovers Python and repository root; no model/GPU requirement.

limitations: This is a selected 100-question Silver diagnostic and remains L0; it is not a full-data result or answer-accuracy estimate.
The circuit has zero trainable parameters and an exact classical matched implementation; this is a feature-interaction screen, not a quantum-advantage test.
The screen uses only compact DPR logits/entropy statistics; the 12 full tensor samples do not establish population-level hidden-state causality.
A positive signal-mechanism screen must be followed by an independent-data evaluation and a separately pre-registered trainable quantum-versus-classical parameter-budget study.
